messages:
Kevin S.: FYI, kickoff with FinGlow tomorrow. They want a search POC with rerank + tool-calls. Need to align success criteria.
Maya R.: main ask: improve top-5 relevancy for KB answers, ingest ~250k docs, context up to 32k. Prefers hosted initially but may move to Dedicated later.
Sam T.: pricing question: rough hosted estimate for 6-week POC with 32k model + rerank? Need a ballpark per-query token cost to justify to procurement.
Arun (SE): For rerank workflow I'd suggest embeddings index + 2-stage rerank. Candidate fetch via FAISS (~1s cold), then a 32k-context model for final rerank + toolcall. Toolcall will be `ticket_lookup(ticket_id)` to pull structured fields from their system.
Liz H.: success criteria proposal: 1) NDCG@5 uplift >= 15% vs current search; 2) mean latency for rerank path < 300ms (95th < 500ms); 3) precision@1 >= 0.7 on a 200-query eval set.
Kevin S.: timeline: week0 kickoff, week1 ingest + indexing, week2 model/proxy tests, week3 evals, week4 tuning, week5 canary, week6 wrap + decision. Customer expects go/no-go by EOW week6.
Maya R.: security Qs from FinGlow: SOC2 report, KMS integration, EU data residency, no long-term retention for raw prompts. Can we confirm options? @security-bot please chime in.
security-bot: SOC2 attestation available. KMS & HSM integrations supported. Private (VPC) deployment option exists for EU region. We can configure request/response retention to 0 days. I'll drop completed SQA answers into the thread.
Sam T.: pricing sanity check: hosted POC estimate ~= $12k for 6 weeks (embeddings + rerank on 32k). This is a placeholder until we get token distribution and QPS. Dedicated baseline will be higher but gives capacity/SLA.
Arun (SE): model choices: "redwood-32k-std" (cost-effective, supports tool calling & prefix caching) vs "redwood-64k-pro" (for longer contexts or larger documents). For embeddings use "open-embed-1024" verified by our catalog. Reranker: either run lightweight distilled reranker or the full 32k model depending on quality.
Liz H.: eval plan: 200 curated queries + 2k synthetic variants. Metrics: NDCG@5, Precision@1, latency histogram, and manual review on 50 edge cases (legal/accounting-related queries). Pass threshold triggers canary rollout.
Kevin S.: blockers: legal needs signed DPA + IP clause, procurement needs SOW and PO. Maya, can you own legal/SQA? Sam to prep SOW & pricing breakdown.
Maya R.: I'll own legal & SQA. I need the initial SQA answers by EOD so I can send to customer tomorrow. Arun will own model baseline & eval harness.
Sam T.: I'll draft SOW and a simple pricing table (hosted vs dedicated + switch costs). Will drop draft by EOD.
Arun (SE): I'll push a minimal eval harness and sample commands: ```python
# run rerank eval
python eval_rerank.py --model redwood-32k-std --queries eval_set.json --topk 5
```
Liz H.: also recommend adding a small human-in-the-loop check for first 500 queries to catch regressions.
Kevin S.: perfect. action owners noted: Maya = legal/SQA, Arun = eval & baseline, Sam = SOW/pricing, Liz = eval metrics. Reconnect after kickoff to adjust thresholds. :thumbsup:
